visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: A Duplicate Maximum Counts as Second
visualizerParams.problemDescription: In 5 5 4 the second largest distinct value is 4, but the program prints 5.

solution.explanation: The second 5 is not larger than first, but it is larger than second, so without the extra test it is stored as the second largest. The condition x != first rejects values equal to the maximum.
